item.name: Necronomicon

effects.title: Demonic Summoning
effects.text: Summons a Warrior and an Archer to fight for you for 60 seconds.

effects.title: Warrior
effects.text:
Burns mana every hit, and deals magical damage to whoever kills it.  Gains True Sight at level 3.
Health: 800
Damage: 25
Mana Break Damage: 30
Last Will Damage: 600

effects.title: Archer
effects.text:
Has a passive movement and attack speed aura. Gains Purge at Level 3.
Health: 800
Damage: 37
Aura Move Speed: 5
Aura Radius: 1200

item.lore: Considered the ultimate in necromancy and demonology, a powerful malefic force is locked within its pages.
